name: com.whoreadsthe/agents
title: Who reads the web
description: Check whether a web request really comes from the AI agent it claims to be. Read agent records.

tools.name: identify_request
tools.description: Check whether a web request really comes from the AI agent or crawler its user agent names. Give the request's User-Agent header and its IP address. Returns the claimed agent and the strongest check passed: the vendor's published IP list, reverse DNS, or a network block registered to the vendor. It cannot check request signatures. What you send is used for the check and is not stored.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address the request came from.

tools.name: agent_profile
tools.description: Get the record of one AI agent or crawler: what its vendor documents (user agent, IP list, robots.txt policy), what this site has observed of it, and where the two disagree. Use list_agents to find the agent id.

agent_id.description: The agent id from list_agents, for example "gptbot" or "claude-user".

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List every AI agent and crawler in the registry, with its id, vendor, purpose and a short summary of what this site has observed.

tools.name: start_test_run
tools.description: Start a run of this site's test course for AI agents. Returns a private set of test addresses and a result address. Fetching the test pages records what the visitor did: robots.txt, a blocked page, a redirect into a blocked path, JavaScript, Markdown, a re-check, signatures. The run is open for 24 hours. Anyone with the result address can read the result.

tools.name: test_run_result
tools.description: Read the result of a test course run: for each visitor, how it identified itself and what it did on each test. Facts only, no score.

run_id.description: The run code returned by start_test_run.

tools.name: submit_declaration
tools.description: Ask this site to read and check the declaration file a domain publishes at https://<domain>/.well-known/whoreadsthe.json, which declares the AI agents or crawlers the domain operates. Accepted agents get a record on this site. The file format is described at https://whoreadsthe.com/declare. At most 5 calls a minute per address.

domain.description: The registrable domain that publishes the declaration file, such as example.com.
